description: This file is a BitBake include recipe for building the QEMU emulator within the OpenEmbedded build system. It defines dependencies, configuration options, patches, and build steps for cross-compiling and testing QEMU in embedded Linux environments.

classes.name: native
classes.description: Overrides for native build configuration, appending host pkg-config path

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the QEMU build system with specified options, setting up the environment for cross-compilation.

methods.name: do_configure:prepend:class-native
methods.description: Prepares the build environment for native (host) compilation, especially pkg-config paths.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built QEMU binaries into the target image directory.

methods.name: do_install_ptest
methods.description: Copies test files to the designated directory and modifies scripts for testing consistency.
